provenance: HELD-OUT, FROZEN AT AUTHORING 2026-08-28 — labels written and committed BEFORE the filing was ever put through this repo's pipeline, per evals/heldout/README.md. One of the TWO REPLACEMENTS owed after ADR-042 §h burned c-2025 and spg-2019. American International Group, Inc. FY2024 10-K, sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/5272/000000527225000012/aig-20241231.htm, accession 0000005272-25-000012, period end 2024-12-31, 12,307,024 bytes, iXBRL. WHY THIS FILING, and it is not the size: AIG is a RUNNING-HEADER filing. Every page of an item repeats that item's name as page furniture, in the exact form `TABLE OF CONTENTS / ITEM 1A | Risk Factors`, so the blind scan counts `Item 7` 52 times and `Item 8` 95 times in one document — against 2 apiece for a conventional filer like Super Micro. Nothing in the committed corpus has this shape: `spaced-letter-heading` breaks a heading's characters, `toc-titled` puts one competing block of item names in the front matter, but AIG puts a competing copy of the heading at the top of EVERY page of the section it belongs to. A heading picker that takes the first match, the last match, or the most-similar match can each land on a page header rather than on the section start, and the failure would look like a plausible span rather than like an error. Item 1's body opens at a different place from its page header, which is what the item-1 anchor tests. SECOND SHAPE, recorded because it is a live prediction and not an aside: AIG carries BOTH per-item Part III headings AND a collective pointer — `ITEM 10 | Directors, Executive Officers and Corporate Governance` is followed by real content and by the sentence `Other information required by Items 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14 of this Form 10-K but not included herein is incorporated by reference from the definitive proxy statement`, while items 11-14 have headings whose entire body is `See Item 10 herein.` (4 occurrences). ADR-042 §c's collective_pointer reads only codes segmentation left UNASSIGNED, so it must NOT fire here; whether items 11-14 land as `extracted` over a four-word internal pointer, or are caught by INTERNAL_REF_RE / item_span_near_empty, is deliberately NOT asserted by this case — the author does not know, and guessing would convert a measurement into a label. ANCHORS, verified by the independent blind reader `tasks/reviews/heldout_blind_scan.py` (imports nothing from src/, so this filing has still never met the pipeline), counts raw/stripped: 'is a leading global insurance organization' 2/2, 'Investing in AIG involves risk' 1/1, 'Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Information' 2/2, 'REFERENCE TO FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SCHEDULES' 1/1. The 2-hit anchors are the TOC-plus-body pattern the case-authoring skill names as acceptable, and they make those checks TOC-trap tripwires as well as boundary ones. LENGTH BANDS are deliberately loose (the item's page range in the filing's own TOC implies item 1 ~ pages 2-11, 1A ~ 12-30, 7 ~ 35-90, 8 ~ 91-190) because a band tight enough to be interesting would be a guess about normalization, which the author cannot make blind.
